# Evident Output 2.0 exported vocabulary (CONTRACT.md symbol tables).
# One line per exported identifier: name, class, concept.
#   canonical: a word of the vocabulary itself.
#   helper:    a part of exactly one concept; never taught alone.
#   removed:   not part of evo 2.0; must not exist in the exported API.
# The concept is the root file stem that declares the identifier (a field or
# method with no declaration of its own takes its type's file).
# The vocabulary guard (vocabulary_guard_test.go) fails when an exported
# identifier is missing here or classed removed.
